name: range-area-chart
title: Range area chart
description: A React range area chart: a line with a min-max band, for forecasts with confidence intervals or daily lows and highs. Gaps stay gaps. Accessible, MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Range area chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/range-area-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { RangeAreaChart, RangeAreaTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/range-area-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
